## Checklist

- [ ] Docs updated (README / `docs/`) if behaviour or API changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased** for user-visible changes
- [ ] No imports of `pdfjs-dist` / `pdf-lib` in the core or `ui` entry points
- [ ] Accessibility considered (labels, focus, keyboard) for UI changes
